diagonal.name: Diagonal
diagonal.idea: A heavy caps headline cut by one diagonal into a deep colour block, a date range led by an arrow, white tiles for dates: the warta card every Indonesian church already knows, drawn at hall size.
refs: diagonal cut, heavy deep-blue caps in two lines, an arrow before the date range
a red wedge across the top and a band at the foot: a limited two-colour set looks premium
the white diagonal wedge is the readable plate, text never sits on a face
airy white card with one blue diagonal sweep at the edge
the time is the loudest element of a service panel

compare.type: Montserrat 800 caps headlines over Barlow Semi Condensed rows
compare.highlight: tile turns solid brand, row gets a tint band and bold name
compare.needs: no polygon primitive: a rotated rect masked by the page

liturgi.name: Liturgi
liturgi.idea: A centred, symmetrical order-of-service card: deep vestment colour, a double gold frame, one small cross, Roman capitals over a book serif.
refs: Gereja Toraja Tamalanrea: deep red field, small gold serif reference above a large white display serif title
seal, thin vertical rule, tracked caps title: a lockup with a two-colour limit
gold on near black with fine lines: premium without heavy ornament
gold outline table, days in a gold serif on charcoal, readable over a dim hall
small tracked caps over a larger serif, a rule below: centred, two sizes

kaca.name: Kaca
kaca.idea: The church's own photograph fills the slide, darkened once; every word sits on one frosted plate, a script word is the only voice on the picture.
refs: a frosted plate over a washed congregation photo keeps strong type calm
a plate reads over a busy bokeh photo
light weight type over a dark photo with a time block at the right
very thin caps over a landscape with a script line: scale and weight contrast
a plate keeps text off faces
dusk photo band over a white data area, the reference for photo plus data

compare.total: solid accent block over the photo, white figure
compare.ornament: none; the photo is the ornament

blok.name: Blok
blok.idea: Hard-edged flat blocks of one signal colour, a near-black and one deep colour; the slide is the blocks, the type is huge and wide, and a highlight is the signal colour poured over a row.
refs: Keynote Photography Bold: a flat saturated field with heavy black type and a hard-edged picture
acid ground with heavy purple caps: loud, high contrast
one colour block and one phrase, the whole slide
black ground, grey blocks, ultra bold caps with tiny corner meta
a solid block marks the special row, outline marks the rest
a deep colour panel with the time as the loudest element

a giant light figure with a small caption on charcoal with soft amber glows
small tracked caps over a larger title on a dark light-burst gradient, one cool colour
the number is the slide on an orange-to-magenta gradient with one light caption
one soft gradient bleeding from a corner is the only colour

huge date numerals with a small day abbreviation, hairline row rules

ledger.item: Read the named inspo files and the colourways-and-archetypes decision first; every choice cites a saved file
Eight new template families, each a clearly different approach, never one layout recoloured
Do not duplicate the minimal default candidates of templates-default.md
At least two drawn from Indonesian church media (church lane)
One photo-led family
One bold colour-block family
One gradient or soft-light family
One magazine editorial family
One data-first family (tables and big numerals)
One seasonal-neutral warm family
Per family: the idea in one sentence and the references it copies, by file
Per family: type (families, weights, px sizes on 1920x1080 for every role), grid (margins, columns), ornaments only the references show
Per family: colour roles, four colourways with hex, contrast ratio of every text-on-ground pair (4.5 body, 3 large and marks)

Per family: all six kinds at the worst case (8 rows over 4 days with one special; 30 names in three columns, 7 highlighted, two months; 6 funds with 12-digit amounts and a total; account with and without QR; 60-word verse; notice with and without a picture)
How a highlight, a total, a continuation slide (1/2) and a date range read in each family
Draw each family's birthday and offering slide at 1920x1080 as SVG wireframes in templates-library/
Write the spec to docs/plans/artosia/templates-library.md
One contact sheet PNG of the SVGs, saying which tool rendered them
A family may name another SIL OFL family from github.com/google/fonts, with the reason
Never run WSL; change no source code
Read the design-questions index; every card has a Contexts line and a Neighbours line, each item an acceptance criterion or n/a with a reason
Draw at least two designs under different pulls, compare them in a table, recommend one
Every plan card lists acceptance criteria as checkable statements a tester can write failing tests from
A screen card names its mock and states the proof is the builder's screenshots against that mock with a table of mock values against measured values
Every text field the mock draws names its keyboard behaviour on iPhone and Android
ledger.dropped: the mock draws no text field: projected slides are read-only, on-slide editing is the existing warta box editor and the phone edits in its own sheet, both unchanged

ledger.item: A design a builder will build ends in a build spec: one data file, exact drawings, the mock drawn from that file, a check script that prints numbers the file lacks
Every unit takes one of the five shapes of creation-pattern.md and is the least code that solves it
A loop is judged by speed and acceleration across its seam
ledger.dropped: the slides are still frames; no motion is drawn or specified

ledger.item: Visual artwork (logo, mark, brand kit) loads the brand skill and writes a Core Brand first
ledger.dropped: no logo, mark or brand kit is drawn; the families are slide layouts and their only marks are layout ornaments cited from the references

ledger.item: A deck or canvas carries a source ledger with a check script that fails while a row is unmapped
